chunks: And in the narration of Hariz:
"They should cast off the covering, recite the Talbiyah, and there is nothing upon them."

key_terms.حَرِيزٍ: Hariz, the narrator to whom this report is attributed
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: anything owed, here meaning a penalty or liability

ai.seo_question: Does removing the covering and reciting the Talbiyah require a penalty for the muhrim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to the state of ihram in hajj. It indicates that removing the face-covering and reciting the Talbiyah entails no penalty in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2685 - In the narration of Hariz:
"They should remove the covering, recite the Talbiyah, and there is nothing upon them (no penalty).
